description: Production Skills for ELMOS deterministic build caching, durable generated-file staging, SOTA adaptive cache optimization, provider prompt-prefix reuse, append-only repository context, environment snapshots, cache affinity, multi-layer coordination, miss diagnostics, Codex/Claude-class parity benchmarks, and SLO-controlled rollout.

skills.title: ELMOS Cache System Architecture
skills.summary: Define the authoritative architecture for deterministic build caching, durable generated-file staging, checkpointing, recovery, and evidence-backed publication across the ELMOS conversion pipeline.

skills.title: Cache Metadata Database
skills.summary: Implement transactional metadata for projects, snapshots, runs, nodes, artifacts, Action Cache entries, staged files, checkpoints, leases, references, events, and outbox jobs.

skills.title: Cache API and CLI Contracts
skills.summary: Define stable APIs and commands for cache lookup, blob transfer, workspace lifecycle, staged-file transitions, checkpoints, run recovery, diagnostics, and administration.

skills.title: Project Snapshot and Merkle Tree
skills.summary: Create deterministic repository snapshots and Merkle trees so small changes invalidate only affected modules, files, symbols, and downstream actions.

skills.title: Content Addressable Storage
skills.summary: Implement immutable, deduplicated, integrity-checked storage for AST, Semantic IR, mapping plans, generated files, patches, build outputs, tests, checkpoints, logs, and evidence bundles.

skills.title: ActionKey and Stage Fingerprinting
skills.summary: Build canonical, explainable cache keys that include every result-affecting input while excluding irrelevant machine-specific noise.

skills.title: Action Cache
skills.summary: Map deterministic ActionKeys to immutable ActionResult manifests, diagnostics, resource usage, provenance, and validation levels.

skills.title: Project Generation File Staging
skills.summary: Provide a durable, recoverable workspace and explicit lifecycle for every file created while ELMOS generates a converted project, including fragments, patches, source maps, manifests, compiler outputs, and final publish candidates.

skills.title: Atomic File Write and Promotion
skills.summary: Implement crash-safe writes, sealing, CAS promotion, complete-tree assembly, atomic publication, and rollback.

skills.title: Sandbox and Overlay Workspaces
skills.summary: Create isolated copy-on-write workspaces combining immutable source snapshots, writable conversion overlays, durable staged output, and disposable scratch data.

skills.title: Intermediate Artifact Manifest
skills.summary: Standardize manifests for CST/AST, symbol tables, type/call/dataflow graphs, Semantic IR, mapping plans, generated fragments, patches, build outputs, tests, repair candidates, and certification evidence.

skills.title: Stage Contract Registry
skills.summary: Require every ELMOS stage to declare input/output schemas, determinism, fingerprint dimensions, cache policy, workspace mounts, resources, side effects, and checkpoint semantics.

skills.title: Semantic and Public Interface Hashing
skills.summary: Separate raw implementation changes from public contract changes so unaffected dependents retain cache hits.

skills.title: Incremental Conversion DAG
skills.summary: Model conversion as a fine-grained deterministic DAG that re-executes only impacted parse, analysis, IR, planning, generation, build, test, repair, and certification nodes.

skills.title: Run Journal and State Machine
skills.summary: Persist authoritative run/node states, append-only events, leases, retries, pause, cancel, stale detection, and recovery ownership.

skills.title: Checkpoint and Resume
skills.summary: Create durable checkpoints at stage and interval boundaries so service or worker failure resumes from verified state instead of restarting the full conversion.

skills.title: Generation Conflict and Merge
skills.summary: Resolve collisions among generators, retries, framework adapters, previous generated output, and user edits without silent data loss.

skills.title: Remote Shared Cache
skills.summary: Scale reuse across workers and teams with S3/MinIO blobs, PostgreSQL metadata, optional Redis leases/hot indexes, resumable transfer, and trust namespaces.

skills.title: Native Build Cache Adapters
skills.summary: Integrate ecosystem-native incremental caches while keeping ELMOS ActionResults, manifests, and evidence authoritative.

skills.title: Cache Security and Provenance
skills.summary: Protect cache and staged output against poisoning, path attacks, malicious artifacts, secret leakage, stale evidence, and cross-tenant access.

skills.title: Cache Retention and Garbage Collection
skills.summary: Control storage growth using pins, protected roots, mark-and-sweep GC, grace periods, cost-based eviction, quarantine retention, and deletion receipts.

skills.title: Cache Observability and Performance
skills.summary: Instrument cache lookup, staging, promotion, recovery, GC, and publication; then tune hit rate and restore economics without weakening correctness.

skills.title: Chaos Testing and Production Certification
skills.summary: Prove crash safety, determinism, security, and operational readiness through replayable fault injection and signed production certification.

skills.title: Cache Trace Capture and Replay Simulator
skills.summary: Capture privacy-safe ELMOS cache workloads and replay them deterministically across modern policies so policy selection is evidence-driven rather than assumed.

skills.title: SOTA Cache Policy Portfolio
skills.summary: Implement a deployable portfolio of SIEVE, S3-FIFO, W-TinyLFU, size-aware and cost-aware policies with modern adaptive candidates and safe fallbacks.

skills.title: DAG-Aware Future-Reuse Prefetch and Placement
skills.summary: Exploit the known ELMOS conversion DAG to predict next use, protect imminent artifacts, prefetch selectively, and place work near cached state.

skills.title: Cost-Aware Admission, Retention, and Eviction
skills.summary: Optimize cache value using recomputation cost, token cost, artifact size, restore latency, validation value, reuse probability, and critical-path impact.

skills.title: Adaptive Cache Policy Orchestrator
skills.summary: Select and tune cache policies off the hot path using workload fingerprints, objective profiles, hysteresis, shadow evaluation, and safe rollback.

skills.title: Learning-Augmented Cache Control Plane
skills.summary: Add S4-FIFO-style asynchronous parameter learning and optional low-overhead learned eviction experiments without putting ML on cache correctness paths.

skills.title: Cache Autotuning and Production Certification
skills.summary: Benchmark, tune, canary, and certify adaptive cache policies against representative ELMOS traces with multi-objective and worst-cohort gates.

skills.title: Rollout and End-to-End Integration
skills.summary: Integrate deterministic caching, durable generated-file staging, adaptive SOTA policy optimization, DAG-aware prefetch, recovery, and certified rollout into the complete ELMOS conversion flow.

skills.title: Provider Prompt Cache Adapters
skills.summary: Implement versioned OpenAI, Anthropic, and self-hosted prompt-prefix cache adapters with capability discovery, exact accounting, safe fallback, and provider-isolated namespaces.

skills.title: Canonical Prompt Prefix Layout
skills.summary: Build deterministic, cache-friendly prompt assembly that maximizes exact stable-prefix reuse while preserving policy, tool, schema, project, and task correctness.

skills.title: Append-Only Repository Context Ledger
skills.summary: Persist repository reads, summaries, diffs, stale markers, and tool observations as an append-only context ledger so unchanged conversation prefixes remain reusable across coding turns.

skills.title: Cache-Preserving Context Compaction
skills.summary: Compact long coding sessions without destroying stable prompt-prefix reuse, provenance, task state, or repository correctness.

skills.title: Environment Snapshot Cache
skills.summary: Cache reproducible sandbox, toolchain, dependency, index, and setup state with precise invalidation so warm ELMOS tasks avoid repeated environment construction.

skills.title: Cache Affinity Routing
skills.summary: Route sessions and DAG nodes to provider cache shards, model replicas, workers, environment snapshots, and local CAS holdings that maximize verified reusable work without sacrificing fairness or availability.

skills.title: Multi-Layer Cache Coordinator
skills.summary: Coordinate provider prompt caches, exact Action Cache, CAS, repository context, environment snapshots, native build caches, and staged artifacts as one correctness-preserving lookup and execution plan.

skills.title: Cache Miss Diagnostics and Invalidation Explainability
skills.summary: Assign every cache miss, bypass, eviction, failed restore, and invalidation a precise machine-readable reason with causal lineage and remediation guidance.

skills.title: Codex/Claude-Class Cache Parity Benchmark
skills.summary: Benchmark ELMOS cache behavior using reproducible coding-agent workloads and hard gates for prompt-token reuse, exact work reuse, incremental invalidation, environment warm starts, recovery, latency, cost, and zero false hits.

skills.title: Cache Hit SLO Autotuning and Regression Control
skills.summary: Continuously tune cache layout, admission, capacity, retention, routing, prefetch, compaction, and environment policy against parity SLOs with safe shadowing, canaries, drift detection, and automatic rollback.

skills.title: Codex/Claude-Class Cache Parity End-to-End Rollout
skills.summary: Integrate and release the complete ELMOS cache parity architecture across prompt, context, deterministic actions, artifacts, environments, routing, diagnostics, benchmarking, and continuous SLO control.

claim_policy.note: Package targets and illustrative fixtures are not production ELMOS results. Claims require a fresh signed parity report bound to code, configuration, provider profile, corpus, and platform.
